When a developer leaves, the code stays. But the reasons behind it walk out the door.
Last Commit interviews them before they go, and pins their thinking to the exact code.
New joiners explore their world: the architecture, the notes, the tools, the team.
Ask their agent anything. And when they didn't know, it says so.
Then it guides you, step by step, to your first commit.
Last Commit. They leave. Their world of work stays.
